title: R3 eyes-fixed sheet anchor annotation (one file per eyes-fixed sheet)
description: Placement METADATA for one raw eyes-fixed sheet (D-169). It never changes pixels. The compositor accepts it only when raw.sha256 equals the sheet's SHA-256, the point names are exactly ringCentre + outerCorner + innerCorner per eye, every point lies on the 1536x1024 sheet with each ring centre in its own half, and status is APPROVED (production). The iris sheet is never annotated: its anchors are the alpha-weighted centroids. The tool (r3-eyes-tool.mjs validateAnnotation) is the enforcing implementation; this schema documents it.

annotationVersion.description: incremented on every correction; a correction is a new file version, never an in-place edit of an approved one

coordinateSpace.const: sheet continuous; pixel i covers [i, i+1); origin = the sheet's top-left; 1536x1024

pointDefinitions.description: the eye targets version whose 'definition' texts the points follow

status.description: only the owner sets APPROVED; SYNTHETIC_TEST_APPROVED is refused in production

innerCorner.description: CHECK point: reported after placement, never fitted
